ORB//TEARDOWN is an independent design study of a Grok Bot orb: a porcelain or obsidian sphere with two stadium capsule eyes and twelve named near-future subsystems.

The page is one object, not a product landing page. A slider, the E key, or desktop scroll opens an exploded view. Parts can be hovered, isolated, and read. Eight hull cuts and ten finishes (porcelain, obsidian, and eight dyes) change the shell without reloading.

The internals are speculative fiction. They are not a real bill of materials and this is not an official SpaceXAI or xAI product.

If WebGL is missing, the same labels sit on a flat poster. Reduced motion skips the automatic explode.
